name: A small team's handoffs
goal: {{work}} Done when {{reviewer}} finds everything asked for is there, and {{approver}} has signed off.

template.title: Team handoffs
template.summary: Who hands what to whom: a request in writing, the work with a handoff note, a review that sends it back, and one person who signs off.
template.whenToUse: Two to five people pass a piece of work between them and things get lost at the handoffs, or nobody is sure who decides it is done.
template.notFor: Work one person does alone (use solo-project), or a team large enough to need a tracker.

slots.ask: What is being done? One or two sentences.
slots.example: The spring newsletter, written, laid out and ready to send.

description: A plan for people; no step here is an agent's. {{requester}} writes down what is wanted. {{author}} does the work and hands it over with a note on what to look at first. {{reviewer}} reads it against the request, and it goes back to {{author}} while something asked for is missing. {{approver}} signs off, or sends it back with a reason. The point is that each handoff says in writing what is being handed, and that one person, named in advance, decides it is done. Nothing here needs a coding harness.

nodes.name: {{requester}} writes the request
nodes.brief: Write what is wanted, by when, and what done looks like, as a short list someone else could check. Say what is not wanted too. If {{author}} has to guess, the request is not finished.
outputs: REQUEST.md: what is wanted, by when, and what done looks like

nodes.name: {{author}} does the work
nodes.brief: Do what the request asks. Hand it over with a note: what is done, what is not and why, and what to look at first. On a later round, start from the review and answer each point, or say why it does not apply.
outputs: HANDOFF.md: what is done, what is not, what to look at first

nodes.name: {{reviewer}} reviews
nodes.brief: Read the work against the request, one line for each thing it asks for: there, with where to see it, or not there. Say what you could not check. You judge and do not fix: what you fix yourself, nobody has reviewed. Verdict pass when everything asked for is there or is named in the handoff note as left out, for a reason you accept.
outputs: REVIEW.md: one line per thing asked for, and a verdict line

nodes.name: {{approver}} signs off
nodes.prompt: {{reviewer}} finds that everything asked for is there. Do you sign off?
options: send it back, with the reason

evidence: the reason it was sent back

bar.name: The request
bar.acceptance: Everything REQUEST.md asks for is there, or is named in HANDOFF.md as left out for a reason the reviewer accepts.
